# MapTogether

> MapTogether (https://maptogether.io) is a free, collaborative (multiplayer) Wardley mapping tool that runs in the browser. Teams edit the same Wardley map in real time, on a canvas or as plain text, with no account or install.

## What it does

- Opening https://maptogether.io starts a blank map; it gets its own URL as soon as you edit it or click Share. Anyone with the link can edit it at the same time; everyone sees each other's named cursors.
- Maps can be drawn on the canvas (double-click to add a component, drag to move, hold Cmd/Ctrl and click two components to link them) or written in the text editor beside it. Both views stay in sync.
- The evolution axis is marked Genesis, Custom, Product and Commodity. Dependencies and pipelines are supported.
- Maps save automatically. It works on desktop browsers, tablets and phones.
- It is free, and in alpha.

## Map syntax

- `Name [visibility, evolution]` places a component; both numbers run from 0 to 100.
- `Needer.Needed` draws a dependency.
- `Name [v, e] { Child [v, e] ... }` makes a pipeline.
- `// comment` lines are ignored.

- App: https://maptogether.io/
